TEST_and_variations:
SELECT DISTINCT Ag.Nom, Ag.Prénom
FROM Client AS Cl1, Client AS Cl2, Contrat AS Co, Agent AS Ag
WHERE Ag.NoAgent=Co.NoAgent 
  And Cl1.NoClient=Co.NoClient 
  AND Cl1.Localité = Cl2.Localité
    and Cl2.NoClient=    11;
TEST_having_2x_count:
SELECT NoAent, Nom, Prénom, Count(NoContrat) AS ['Contrats conclus']
FROM Agent, Contrat
WHERE Agent.NoAgent = Contrat.NoAgent
GROUP BY NoAgent, Nom, Prénom
HAVING Count(NoContrat) >= 2
ORDER BY COUNT(NoContrat) DESC;
TEST_join_same_table:
SELECT DISTINCT Ag.Nom, Ag.Prénom
FROM Agent AS Ag, Contrat AS Co1, Contrat AS Co2
WHERE Ag.NoAgent = Co1.NoAgent
AND Co1.NoAgent <> Co2.Noagent
AND Co1.NoClient = Co2.NoClient;
TEST_max:
SELECT Max(Prime) AS ['Plus grande Prime']
FROM Contrat AS C, Agent AS A
WHERE C.NoAgent=A.NoAgent
AND Pays = 'Belgique'
AND AgentGénéral=No;
TEST_top_4:
SELECT TOP 4 noClient, Nom, Prénom
FROM Client;
TEST_union1:
SELECT Nom, Localité
FROM Client
UNION SELECT Nom, Localité
      FROM Agent
ORDER BY Localité;
TEST_union2:
SELECT Nom, Localité, 'Client' AS Type
FROM Client
UNION SELECT Nom, Localité, 'Agent' AS Type
FROM Agent
ORDER BY Localité;
